description: Revert your own last editing tool call(s) this session (add/edit/delete/move/duplicate_section, insert_block, update_settings, page tools…), newest first. Does NOT undo symbol or asset tools. Refuses (returns `blocked`) when a page, CSS or settings it would restore has been edited since, so hand edits are never overwritten. Paths may shift — call read_page afterwards.

steps.description: How many tool calls to revert. Default 1.

name: swebsy_undo
title: Undo
